name: Belmont High School
text: Belmont Senior High School is a public high school located at 1575 West 2nd Street in the Westlake community of Los Angeles, California. The school, which serves grades 9 through 12, is part of the Los Angeles Unified School District.

depictions.name: Belmont High School
depictions.text: is a location in L.A. Noire. It is featured in the Homicide case The Golden Butterfly.
